canonical_identity.problem: append-only recovery attempts use per-attempt unique paths after non-atomic preflight so concurrent recoverers can both become successor candidates for the same stale predecessor.
acceptance: a concurrency canary with two or more recoverers proves one successor started for the same predecessor generation while late-original reconciliation remains preserved.
a losing recoverer resolves the winning recovery claim and does not persist started for duplicate execution.
if the elected recovery later becomes stale a next recovery generation can be elected without mutating prior evidence.
the same stale predecessor and recovery generation yields exactly one recovery election winner via create-if-absent or equivalent cas.
